author: ETA PRIME
description:
We are testing out Intel's brand new Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus!
We Use the new Core Ultra 7 270K+ to see if it’s the ultimate CPU for a high-end Mini-ITX build! At $299, this 24-core, 24-thread CPU brings higher clocks and more cache to the table compared to the 265K, but the real star of the show is Intel's new Binary Optimization Tool. We put the 270K+ and an RTX 5080 to the test in a Mini-ITX B860 rig to see exactly how much "free" performance we can squeeze out of games like Cyberpunk 2077 and apps like Geekbench 6 just by toggling the optimization software on. We also run it head-to-head against the Ultra 7 265K and AMD's Ryzen 7 9700X in Cinebench R24, Blender, and 4K gaming!
